measurement.metric: Cloudflare native invocation CPU and Wall; not client latency
measurement.design: Sequential deployments; not isolate-controlled or randomized A/B

limitations: Latest source 0582d86 has composed medians 11ms, 6ms, 6ms across three deployments. Do not hide the failed earlier acceptance or attribute later changes to unmodified code.

Residual and confirm pretest observability has traces enabled; phase2b pretest traces were disabled. Runtime settings differ as well as deployment/isolate/time; no specific cause of variance established.
No new production optimization was implemented after phase2b.
External list and address data may be cached according to existing policy; these are warmed-path results, not guaranteed cold-path CPU.
Warmups remain in evidence, outside reported steady-state percentiles. Median/p95 do not guarantee future CPU compliance.
Counts exclude fixture subrequests and control-plane calls.

observabilityInterpretation.snapshotMeaning: observabilityPretestSnapshot records settings before each measurement round; it is not the runtime setting for invocation logging.
observabilityInterpretation.tracesDuringMeasurement: The runner did not toggle traces; tracing stayed at the pretest snapshot value for the stage.
observabilityInterpretation.consequence: Invocation logging did not differ between stages. Tracing did differ between earlier stages (false) and residual/confirm (true).

separateInterleavedExperiment.limitation: Separate experiment; not combined with the 576 attempts above.
separateInterleavedExperiment.platformFailureCpuInterpretation: Truncated at the CPU limit after exceededCpu; not the full execution cost.
